name: log_follow_stop
title: Stop Log Follow
description: Closes a log-follow handle and releases its state.

handle.description: Opaque log-follow handle returned by log_follow_start.

status.description: completed on success, failed on error.

tool.description: Echo of the invoked tool name.

client_id.description: Echo of the target host id (null for handle-scoped calls).

error.description: Machine-readable error code when status is failed.

retryable.description: Whether a failed call may succeed on retry.
